array.string: sleep 5 # アップデータによる再起動を待つ [ -f "$HOME/.zshrc.local" ] && source "$HOME/.zshrc.local" args=() for v in HTTPS_PROXY HTTP_PROXY NO_PROXY; do [ -n "${(P)v}" ] && args+=(--env "$v=${(P)v}") done if pid=$(pgrep -x Raycast); then (( ${#args} )) || exit 0 ps eww -o command= -p $pid | grep -q 'HTTPS_PROXY=' && exit 0 kill $pid for i in {1..20}; do pgrep -x Raycast >/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done fi exec /usr/bin/open -a Raycast "${args[@]}"
